need.title: IT director needs SAML SSO with Okta to enforce single sign-on across the organization and eliminate standalone passwords for Brightboard
need.problem: Brightboard does not support SAML SSO with Okta, forcing users to maintain separate credentials instead of using the standardized corporate identity provider
need.job_to_be_done: Standardize authentication across all SaaS tools on Okta and prevent password fallback

requests:
SAML SSO with Okta
We're standardising every SaaS tool on Okta by Q1 and Brightboard is one of the last apps where people still have a separate password. We need SAML 2.0 SSO with Okta, ideally with SSO enforced for our domain so nobody can fall back to a password.

Azure AD / Entra ID single sign-on
Our security policy requires every third-party app to authenticate through Entra ID with conditional access. Until that's possible we can't onboard the wider finance org. Is OIDC with Azure AD on the roadmap?

SSO is a hard requirement for the Vantage deal
Vantage's CISO confirmed on today's call: no SSO, no deal. They're on Okta and need SAML with MFA enforced through the IdP. It's a $380k opportunity and they want to sign by end of November. Can we give them a date?

IT won't roll out without SSO
Honestly the dashboards are great, but our IT team won't approve rolling Brightboard out past the pilot group without SSO. We're on Azure AD. About 40 people are waiting on this.

okta integration??
is there an okta integration? couldn't find it in settings. we have 60 users and managing passwords by hand is a pain
author: robert

need.title: End user needs dark mode to reduce eye strain when viewing dashboards at night
need.problem: Staring at a white dashboard at 11pm causes eye strain and discomfort
need.job_to_be_done: View dashboards comfortably in low-light conditions without eye fatigue

requests:
dark mode pls
staring at a white dashboard at 11pm is brutal. dark mode please 🙏

Dark theme option
Our front desk screen shows the dashboard all day and the bright white is tiring on the eyes. A dark theme would be nice.

Dark mode
+1 for dark mode. Every other tool I use has it.

Dark theme for the app
We get asked about dark mode on Twitter and in G2 reviews regularly. Low effort if we tokenise colours first. Mostly a delighter for SMB and prosumer users.
author: robert

need.title: Operations manager needs to distribute sales dashboard to stakeholders without Brightboard access without manual effort
need.problem: Currently manually taking screenshots and emailing them weekly, which is time-consuming and does not scale
need.job_to_be_done: Get sales data to regional managers who don't have dashboard access

requests:
Schedule a dashboard to email every Monday
Our regional managers don't have Brightboard seats and never will. Every Monday I screenshot the sales dashboard and paste it into an email. Can I schedule the dashboard to be emailed to a list automatically?

Weekly PDF of client dashboards
We send each client a performance report every Friday, and right now an analyst exports each dashboard by hand. A weekly PDF that goes out on its own (with our logo, ideally) would save us half a day a week.

Board members need the monthly numbers without logging in
Hannah at Orchard emails a PDF of the co-op dashboard to 9 board members every month. She asked whether Brightboard can send it for her on a schedule. The board members won't be getting accounts.

post KPI summary to slack channel
every morning i copy numbers from 3 dashboards into our #daily-numbers channel. if brightboard could post a summary there automatically that would be amazing

Email report to warehouse shift leads
Our warehouse shift leads need the throughput numbers at 6am but they don't use Brightboard. A scheduled email with the key numbers would do it. It doesn't need to be interactive.

make it better
the dashboards are kinda clunky. make it better?
author: robert

need.title: Data engineer needs a native Snowflake connector to eliminate the manual data copy pipeline into Postgres
need.problem: They currently must copy data from Snowflake to Postgres as an extra step because Brightboard does not have native Snowflake support
need.job_to_be_done: Connect Brightboard directly to Snowflake without maintaining a separate Postgres copy pipeline

requests:
Native Snowflake connector
We moved our warehouse to Snowflake. Today we copy data into Postgres just so Brightboard can read it. A native Snowflake connector with key-pair auth would let us drop that pipeline.

Connect to Snowflake
Our data team standardised on Snowflake. Is a connector planned? It would unblock moving our remaining reports into Brightboard.

Quanta Payments asks for Snowflake
Quanta's data lives in Snowflake, and it came up in the demo as a must-have for their embedded use case too. Without it they'd have to build and maintain an extract.
author: robert

need.title: SMB owner needs to visualize sales data from an Excel sheet without setting up database connections or data sources
need.problem: They currently maintain sales data in an Excel sheet but cannot easily create charts or visualizations from it in Brightboard; they lack access to database connectors or data infrastructure
need.job_to_be_done: Visualize and analyze sales data from an existing Excel spreadsheet

requests:
Upload my spreadsheet
I keep my sales in an Excel sheet. Can I just upload it and get charts? I don't have a database or any of the fancy connectors.

Import appointment data from a CSV
Our booking software exports appointments as a CSV. I'd like to import it and see no-show rates by weekday, but I couldn't find an import button anywhere.
author: robert

need.title: Finance Controller needs to export Brightboard data to Excel with numeric formatting to build the month-end pack for the CFO
need.problem: Currently unable to export table data to Excel in a format where numbers are preserved as numbers rather than text, which breaks formulas when rebuilding P&L and cost-per-shipment tables
need.job_to_be_done: Export dashboard table data to Excel with proper numeric formatting so formulas can reference the values in downstream financial reporting

requests:
Export to Excel for the month-end pack
At month end I rebuild our P&L and cost-per-shipment tables in Excel for the finance pack that goes to the CFO. I need to export the underlying table to .xlsx with numbers as numbers, not text, so my formulas keep working.

Excel export keeps turning numbers into text
When I download a table as CSV and open it in Excel, the currency columns come in as text and I lose an hour fixing them before the monthly management pack. A proper Excel export would solve it.

xlsx download of the monthly figures
Our auditors and the board treasurer want the monthly numbers in a spreadsheet they can tick and annotate. Could we download a dashboard's tables as one Excel file, with a tab per chart?

Excel export for month-end close
Ticket #51877. The finance team at Atlas Freight is asking how to get the revenue-by-lane table into Excel for their month-end close. They copy-paste from the browser and the totals don't match because of rounding.
author: robert

need.title: Analyst needs dashboards to load faster so users will actually view them instead of requesting manual exports
need.problem: A 25-chart clinical ops dashboard takes 30-40 seconds to load, causing users to give up and request screenshots instead
need.job_to_be_done: Reduce dashboard load time to acceptable levels so end users will use self-service dashboards rather than asking for manual data pulls

requests:
Dashboards take 30+ seconds to load
Our clinical ops dashboard has about 25 charts and takes 30-40 seconds to load every morning. People give up and ask me for screenshots instead.

Slow dashboard complaints from Meridian
Ticket #50102. Meridian reports that the treasury dashboard times out on the 'last 12 months' filter. Their data is around 80M rows. Escalated twice already.

Performance with large date ranges
Anything over six months of data and the dashboard spinner just sits there. Could you cache results or pre-aggregate?

Northwind exec dashboard loading slowly
Ticket #52990. Northwind's exec dashboard takes about 45 seconds on Monday mornings when everyone opens it at once. They're asking whether they need a bigger plan.
author: robert

need.title: IT Director needs automatic user provisioning from Okta to avoid manual seat management and address annual audit findings about offboarding
need.problem: Manual user provisioning and deprovisioning creates audit findings every year, particularly around offboarding when employees leave
need.job_to_be_done: Automate user lifecycle management (creation and removal of seats) when employees join or leave Okta

requests:
Auto-provision users from Okta (SCIM)
Following up on SSO: once that's in, we also need SCIM so that when someone joins or leaves in Okta their Brightboard seat is created or removed automatically. Offboarding comes up as an audit finding for us every year.

Deprovisioning when employees leave
Last quarter we found 23 Brightboard accounts belonging to people who had left the bank. Deprovisioning needs to follow Entra ID group membership, not a manual cleanup someone remembers to do.

Helix wants users synced with their AD groups
From the Helix QBR: Sandra's team wants Brightboard users and teams to follow their Azure AD groups automatically, adds and removals both. They called it 'SCIM or something like it'. It came up in the renewal conversation.
author: robert

need.title: SMB owners need pre-built starter templates to quickly set up dashboards and reach value without blank-slate complexity
need.problem: New SMB customers have empty workspaces after signing and don't know how to begin building dashboards, delaying time-to-value
need.job_to_be_done: Get up and running with a functional dashboard quickly without building from scratch

requests:
Starter templates for new customers
Greenway signed six weeks ago and still has an empty workspace. SMBs don't know where to start. Starter templates like 'dental practice KPIs' or 'retail sales' would get them to value much faster.

starter dashboards?
signed up last week. is there a template for an agency, like billable hours and project margin? building from scratch is a bit overwhelming tbh
author: robert

need.title: Carely needs to embed white-labeled Brightboard dashboards in their patient portal so clinic customers see only their own data
need.problem: Carely cannot currently offer embedded analytics within their patient portal without building analytics from scratch
need.job_to_be_done: Enable clinic customers to view their analytics dashboards within Carely's patient portal without leaving the application

requests:
Embed dashboards in Carely's patient portal
Carely (prospect, $120k) wants to embed Brightboard dashboards in the portal their clinic customers log into, with each clinic seeing only its own data. They'd white-label it. This is the whole deal for them.

Embedded analytics for Quanta's merchant dashboard
Quanta Payments wants to show each merchant their own sales analytics inside Quanta's app. They need embedding via iframe or an SDK, SSO pass-through, and per-merchant data isolation. $260k pipeline.

Show our customers their usage dashboards
We'd like to put a usage dashboard inside our own product so our customers can see their adoption. Is there an embed option?
